summary: Elevate your career with our Expeditor Career Development Program. Gain essential skills and knowledge to excel in the fast-paced logistics industry.
lede: Expediting operations training is for procurement expeditors, project expeditors, and materials coordinators who manage supplier deliverables. It develops skills in tracking purchase order milestones, verifying manufacturing and document status, coordinating inspections, assessing delivery risks, and planning recovery actions. Learners also practise creating trackers, dashboards, status reports, and escalation briefs to support clearer delivery decisions.
audienceIntro: This intermediate expediting operations programme suits professionals who already work with purchase orders, suppliers, project schedules, or materials data and need stronger control, analysis, and escalation capability.
prerequisites: You should have approximately one year of exposure to purchase orders, supplier follow-up, procurement coordination, materials control, project schedules, or logistics activities. No programming is required. You should be comfortable reading basic procurement records and working with spreadsheet tables. Advanced analytics and AI-assisted supplier analysis are taught at an operational application level, not a technical engineering level. Bring representative, anonymized purchase order or supplier status examples if available.
